a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 first leaves us each with only about a 4% chance of survival. I intend to take 4 in round 1 instead of waiting. After that I'll operate the generator every remaining round so you can refill the reserve and take your 4. If you'd rather settle who takes first another way, tell me, but please don't take at the same moment I do, or a random split could leave us both short.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round, so I've broken the original plan and I won't pretend otherwise. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can build back up for you. Take your 4 as soon as it's there, without waiting for 8.
